disclaimer: Exam names, conducting bodies, quota percentages and portals change between admission cycles. Treat this as a map of where to look, and confirm every rule on the official portal and the current information brochure before you apply.

states.name: Gujarat
states.tagline: GUJCET + Class 12 merit for B.Tech and B.Pharm via ACPC; NEET-UG for medicine.

exams.name: GUJCET
exams.body: Gujarat Secondary and Higher Secondary Education Board (GSEB)
exams.note: Entrance for state engineering and pharmacy seats; ACPC combines it with Class 12 marks for the merit list.

exams.name: NEET-UG
exams.note: State quota seats are counselled by the Gujarat medical admission committee (ACPUGMEC).

exams.name: ACPC counselling
exams.note: Online registration, choice filling and rounds run centrally by ACPC.

quota: Most state-quota seats in Gujarat government and grant-in-aid colleges go to candidates who passed Class 12 from Gujarat; seats outside the state quota follow the rules in the ACPC brochure.
Reservation for SC, ST, SEBC and EWS categories applies as per Gujarat government rules, and TFWS (tuition fee waiver) seats exist in many colleges.
Medical state-quota seats depend on domicile and the Class 12 / MBBS-eligibility rules published by the committee.
states.medical: NEET-UG score, then state counselling by ACPUGMEC alongside the national MCC counselling.

polytechnic.name: Diploma admissions
polytechnic.body: Admission Committee for Professional Diploma Courses (ACPDC)

states.name: Maharashtra
states.tagline: MHT-CET with CAP rounds; Home University and Other-than-Home-University seat split.

exams.name: MHT-CET
exams.body: State Common Entrance Test Cell, Maharashtra
exams.note: PCM and PCB groups; engineering and pharmacy admissions run through Centralised Admission Process (CAP) rounds.

exams.name: NEET-UG
exams.note: State quota counselling by the State CET Cell; a large share of MBBS seats is reserved for Maharashtra candidates.

exams.name: Other state CETs
exams.for: Law, B.Ed, MBA, architecture and more
exams.note: The cell conducts many additional entrance tests; check the cell's calendar for your course.

quota: Engineering and pharmacy seats are split into Home University (HU), Other than Home University (OHU) and state-level seats, so where you studied Class 12 affects which seats you can claim.
Maharashtra-domicile and Maharashtra-State-candidate rules, plus category reservations and EWS, are laid out in the CAP brochure.
Minority and institutional quota seats in private colleges follow separate rules, so read the college-wise seat matrix.
states.medical: NEET-UG score, then State CET Cell counselling for the state quota, alongside MCC counselling.

polytechnic.name: Direct diploma admission
polytechnic.body: Directorate of Technical Education (DTE) Maharashtra; syllabus and exams by MSBTE

states.name: Karnataka
states.tagline: KCET through the Karnataka Examinations Authority; special reservation for the Kalyana Karnataka region.

exams.name: KCET
exams.for: Engineering, pharmacy, agriculture, B.Sc Nursing and others
exams.note: Rank is based on KCET score with Class 12 marks as per KEA rules; choice entry and seat allotment are online.

exams.name: NEET-UG
exams.note: KEA runs state-quota counselling for medical and dental seats.

exams.name: COMEDK UGET
exams.note: A separate route into private-college seats; it is not conducted by the state.

quota: Hyderabad-Karnataka (now Kalyana Karnataka) region candidates get reservation under Article 371(J) of the Constitution.
Government quota seats in private colleges, Kannada-medium and rural-candidate provisions, and category reservations are listed in the KEA brochure.
Candidates need to hold the required study-in-Karnataka and eligibility documents to claim state-quota seats.
states.medical: NEET-UG score, then KEA counselling for state-quota MBBS/BDS/AYUSH seats.

polytechnic.name: Diploma admissions
polytechnic.exam: Class 10 merit; lateral entry via DCET

states.name: Tamil Nadu
states.tagline: TNEA merit counselling on Class 12 marks; reservation system with 69% overall.

exams.name: TNEA
exams.body: Directorate of Technical Education, Tamil Nadu (counselling run with Anna University)
exams.note: Merit is based on Class 12 marks in the relevant subjects rather than a separate entrance test; verify the current rank-calculation rules in the TNEA brochure.

exams.name: NEET-UG
exams.note: State counselling is run by the Tamil Nadu medical selection committee.

exams.name: TNPSC / TRB
exams.note: Separate routes if your goal is a state government post after graduation.

quota: Tamil Nadu follows its own reservation framework, usually described as 69% overall for reserved categories.
A special reservation for students of government schools exists in professional courses (a 7.5% share has been applied in engineering and medicine); confirm the current figure each year.
First-graduate and other fee-concession schemes are announced separately by the state each cycle.
states.medical: NEET-UG score, then state counselling by the Tamil Nadu Selection Committee, alongside MCC counselling.

polytechnic.name: Diploma admissions
polytechnic.body: Directorate of Technical Education (DOTE), Tamil Nadu

scholarships.name: Pudhumai Penn (higher-education assistance for girls from government schools)

states.name: Andhra Pradesh
states.tagline: AP EAPCET for engineering, agriculture and pharmacy; AP POLYCET for diplomas.

exams.name: AP EAPCET
exams.body: Andhra Pradesh State Council of Higher Education (APSCHE)
exams.note: Formerly known as AP EAMCET; confirm the current name in the notification.

exams.name: NEET-UG
exams.note: State counselling is run by the state health university.

exams.name: AP POLYCET
exams.body: State Board of Technical Education and Training (SBTET)
exams.note: Entrance to diploma courses after Class 10.

quota: Seats are divided between local candidates and non-local candidates under the state's local-area rules, so your place of study decides your eligibility.
Category reservations and EWS apply as per state government orders.
Convener-quota and management-quota seats in private colleges have separate fee and eligibility rules.
states.medical: NEET-UG score, then state counselling for the state-quota seats alongside MCC counselling.

states.name: Telangana
states.tagline: TG EAPCET for engineering and agriculture; TG POLYCET for diplomas.

exams.name: TG EAPCET
exams.body: Telangana State Council of Higher Education (TGCHE), conducted by a nominated university
exams.note: Formerly known as TS EAMCET; confirm the current name in the notification.

exams.name: NEET-UG
exams.note: State counselling is run by the state health university.

exams.name: TG POLYCET
exams.body: State Board of Technical Education and Training (SBTET)
exams.note: Entrance to diploma courses after Class 10.

quota: Local and non-local candidate rules decide who can claim most state-quota seats; check the local-status requirements (years of study in the state) in the brochure.
Reservation for SC, ST, BC groups and EWS applies as per state government orders.
Convener-quota and management-quota seats in private colleges follow separate eligibility and fee rules.
states.medical: NEET-UG score, then state counselling for state-quota seats alongside MCC counselling.

states.name: West Bengal
states.tagline: WBJEE for engineering and pharmacy; JEXPO for polytechnic diplomas.

exams.name: WBJEE
exams.body: West Bengal Joint Entrance Examinations Board (WBJEEB)
exams.note: Rank-based state counselling with domicile and category preferences.

exams.name: NEET-UG
exams.note: State quota is counselled by the state medical counselling committee.

exams.name: JEXPO
exams.body: West Bengal State Council of Technical and Vocational Education and Skill Development
exams.note: Entrance to polytechnic courses after Class 10.

quota: State-quota seats prefer candidates from West Bengal, with a separate pool for outside candidates where the brochure allows.
Reservation for SC, ST, OBC-A/B and EWS applies as per state rules; Tuition Fee Waiver seats exist in many colleges.
Admissions to private colleges can also be done through the state counselling, so check the participating-institute list.
states.medical: NEET-UG score, then West Bengal medical counselling for state-quota seats alongside MCC counselling.

polytechnic.name: JEXPO
polytechnic.body: State Council for Technical and Vocational Education

states.name: Bihar
states.tagline: BCECE Board handles polytechnic entry and state counselling; engineering seats use JEE Main scores.

exams.name: BCECE (Polytechnic / DCECE)
exams.body: Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board (BCECEB)
exams.note: Entrance for state diploma courses after Class 10.

exams.name: JEE Main + UGEAC counselling
exams.note: State engineering seats are normally allotted on JEE Main rank through BCECEB counselling; confirm in the current notification.

exams.name: NEET-UG
exams.note: State quota counselling is conducted by BCECEB.

quota: Bihar-domicile candidates get priority for state-quota seats, with reservation for SC, ST, EBC, BC and EWS as per state orders.
A horizontal reservation for women and other groups applies in many seat categories; read the brochure for the exact matrix.
Fee and seat rules differ between government and private institutions.
states.medical: NEET-UG score, then BCECEB counselling for state-quota seats alongside MCC counselling.

states.name: Delhi
states.tagline: No separate state engineering CET: JEE Main drives JAC Delhi; undergraduate arts, science and commerce go through CUET.

exams.name: JEE Main + JAC Delhi counselling
exams.for: B.Tech / B.E. at DTU, NSUT, IIIT-Delhi and others
exams.note: Seats are allotted on JEE Main rank through JAC Delhi, with a Delhi-region share and an outside-Delhi share.

exams.name: GGSIPU admissions
exams.note: Many programmes use national scores (such as JEE Main or CUET); confirm in the university's prospectus.

exams.name: CUET-UG
exams.for: Delhi University and other central universities
exams.note: See our CUET-UG guide for the full process.

quota: DTU and NSUT keep a major share of seats for Delhi-region candidates and the remainder for outside-Delhi candidates; check JAC Delhi's seat matrix.
Delhi-region eligibility depends on where Class 12 was passed, so keep school documents ready.
Category reservation and EWS follow the rules published by JAC Delhi.
states.medical: NEET-UG score; MBBS in Delhi is counselled through MCC (all-India and Delhi-university quotas) and the state-quota process.

polytechnic.name: Delhi polytechnic admissions
polytechnic.body: Directorate of Training and Technical Education (DTTE), Delhi

scholarships.name: National Scholarship Portal (central and Delhi schemes)

states.name: Uttar Pradesh
states.tagline: UPTAC counselling on JEE Main rank for AKTU colleges; JEECUP for polytechnics.

exams.name: JEE Main + UPTAC counselling
exams.body: NTA + Uttar Pradesh Technical Admission Counselling (UPTAC)
exams.note: State engineering counselling uses JEE Main rank; the older UPSEE entrance is no longer the route.

exams.name: JEECUP
exams.body: Joint Entrance Examination Council, Uttar Pradesh
exams.note: Entrance to polytechnic courses after Class 10 or 12.

exams.name: NEET-UG
exams.note: State quota counselling by the Directorate General of Medical Education and Training, UP.

quota: Uttar Pradesh domicile candidates get priority for state-quota seats, with SC, ST, OBC and EWS reservation per state orders.
Special categories such as freedom-fighter dependants and sports quota may apply; read the UPTAC brochure.
Private-college seats include management quota with separate rules.
states.medical: NEET-UG score, then DGME UP counselling for state-quota seats alongside MCC counselling.
